title: Bug fields reach MCP, the snapshot and the overview, and the PATH genlock runs the bug commands

requirements.text: the MCP server lists tools for bug, cause, classes and retro, and new accepts bug
genlock snapshot gives each ticket a bug object with class, system, scope and missing fields, and each goal a bugs_since_retro count
genlock overview or orient shows a goal's bugs-since-retro count once it reaches the retro threshold
genlock classes exits 0 from the genlock on PATH
the bug work is committed by path, leaving other sessions' uncommitted files out

evidence: tests/bugs.mjs test 12: MCP tools/list includes ticket_bug, bug_cause, bug_classes, bug_class_add, retro; ticket_new schema has bug and found_by; bug_classes and tickets_list calls return the right rows
tests/bugs.mjs test 10: snapshot ticket A bug.class=clock-domain-mismatch, missing=[]; C missing=['preventive']; unmarked ticket bug=null; goal town bugs.total=6 since_retro=0 last_retro retro2.md

tests/bugs.mjs test 11: orient silent after 9 closed bugs; after the 10th, done prints '10 bug tickets have closed on menus' and orient prints '10 bugs closed since the last retro: offer the user one (genlock retro G-..)'; snapshot retro_due=true

after copying CLI into /Applications/Genlock.app and re-signing (codesign --verify ok): PATH genlock classes --counts -> 'no classified bugs yet.' exit 0; genlock mcp tools/list shows bug_cause, retro, ticket_bug; snapshot goals[0].bugs present
